async/atomic#

One value that tasks share and replace whole.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let hits = Atomic(0);
hits.replace(hits.value() + 1);
if hits.compare_and_replace(expected: 3, revised: 0) { … }

Description#

One value that tasks share and replace whole.

Every operation is synchronous and has no suspension point, so it is whole with respect to other tasks. compare_and_replace publishes only when the value equals expected; equality is structural. Two atomics are equal only when they are the same atomic, whatever they hold, and an atomic cannot key a map. For a value only synchronous code touches, cell's Cell is enough.
